rationale: Session HITL approval is recorded without approver identity for exactly this local remediation and validation scope: eliminate intermediate .horo symlink TOCTOU from secure traversal then pathname reopen; make returned receipts verifiable after live-claim release; prevent a worktree-local .horo replay ledger from removal by git clean; prevent public execute_invocation from leaking the global lock; handle partial writes rather than one os.write; provide fail-closed fcntl/POSIX and macOS realpath-containment compatibility; and replace global store locking that prevents safe non-overlap concurrency. No unrelated refactor is authorized. Deploy, publish, push, secrets, account, external, destructive, configuration, generated-file, and PII actions are excluded; external actions remain unused and target-gated. The session authorization permits bounded workspace-ticket improvement, refactoring, fixes, and removal of explicitly identified obsolete code/tests, never a /root glob deletion or broad/unrelated destructive action. A new independent read-only TICKET-PRIORITY-004 re-review is required before final reconciliation.
